_comment: Distinct UFC fighters who share one ufcstats name. Every input row is keyed by name, so without this their fights merge into one profile. Each bout listed here is rewritten to the split-off name before any record, stat, history or Elo is computed. Key bouts by event + opponent, never by weight class (the per-round stats and fight details carry none).

splits.note: Bruno 'Blindado' Silva, middleweight, b. 1989-07-13. The roster's Bruno Silva is the flyweight 'Bulldog' (b. 1990-03-16).
